node.title: Descend constant hyperplanes with primitive degree and original weights
node.statement: In a regular MCA prefix with shared s and pair dimension2s-3, a maximal constant(s-1) subspace stays maximal at a nonroot anchor and loses at least one primitive scalar degree; at its at most D-E common-root coordinates the child has full constant carrier with primitive degree E. Full constant carriers persist under further regular anchors. Degree-refined same-field scalar LIST prices and original weighted compression give a normalized recurrence in zeta=E-(s-2), with root allowance J1-10-zeta_low and exact original anchor factors. No normalization cap or separability premise. The finite consumer proves all cost inputs; no actual occupation is assumed.
